OpenMenu.note: externalOpen forces the real open state — the portalled POPOVER_SURFACE_CLASS panel with four menu items (one destructive) anchored bottom/start under the trigger.

WithShortcuts.note: side='right' with a PaneIconButton trigger shows the placement axis and the trailing ShortcutBadge treatment; the surface renders beside the trigger as configured.

ClosedTrigger.note: Resting trigger only, confirming the trigger element is passed through untouched (Button keeps its own styling).
